question: Who received the Vyas Samman for the novel "Patliputru Ki Samragi"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prof. Sharad Pagare.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Professor Sharad Pagare**, a distinguished Hindi writer, was awarded the **Vyas Samman 2020 **for his novel** "Patliputra ki Samragi." **
 
• He is recognized for his** notable contributions to Hindi literature **and has also received the **Bharat Bhushan Samman** and **Madhya Pradesh Sahitya Akademi awards. **
 
• Apart from being an accomplished writer, Prof. Sharad Pagare is a renowned researcher, professor
